scope: WebArena Magento storefront shared-runtime inference backend

components.name: mysql
components.reset: replace active datadir from immutable Magento template
components.fork: reflink cold checkpoint datadir into target branch
components.notes: The PHP application consumes only the signed route registry endpoint.

components.name: media
components.reset: discard branch delta; immutable baseline remains shared
components.notes: Reads and add-only writes are routed, but replacement/deletion whiteouts are not implemented. All current tasks exclude media mutations and future media-mutating tasks fail closed.

components.name: sessions
components.notes: Preserves WebArena storage-state login cookies without cross-tenant files.

components.name: redis_cache
components.notes: Only derived Magento cache/page-cache data uses shared Redis.

components.name: queue
components.reset: quiesce request and restore queue tables with MySQL branch
components.fork: fork queue tables with MySQL checkpoint
components.notes: The shared image disables cron; no unscoped consumer may run.

components.name: opensearch
components.reset: delete target prefix and rebuild catalogsearch_fulltext
components.fork: rebuild target prefix from the forked MySQL branch
components.notes: Index prefix comes from the trusted route and never from an HTTP parameter.

components.name: mail
components.notes: Official contact-draft tasks only populate browser-local form fields and exclude mail. Any task that actually sends mail is rejected by the capability gate.
